summary: Overlapping Avatars with a `+N` overflow, for showing several people in one row's width.
useWhen: several people share one thing — assignees, participants, collaborators
the exact list matters less than the fact that there are several

useInstead.when: each person needs their own name, role or action visible
useInstead.why: an overlapping stack hides everything but the picture

mini.use: 24px — inline beside body text, dense table rows

children.note: group `size`/`shape` fill in only where a child has not set its own; a child's explicit prop wins. Non-Avatar children are left untouched.

requires: `alt` on every child Avatar — the overflow avatar is the only one the group names for you
notes: Children paint in source order, so the `+N` overflow lands on top without any z-index.

antiPatterns.why: twenty overlapping avatars is not a summary; it is a smear
